headlines.title_he: מדינות האזור מברכות על הסכם מכה בין טורקיה, ערב הסעודית ופקיסטן

headlines.title: Attack on one is attack on all, say Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan in joint defence pact
headlines.snippet: Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan affirmed that an attack on one is an attack on all within their joint defense pact. This highlights the collective security nature of the agreement.
headlines.title_he: מתקפה על אחד היא מתקפה על כולם, אומרים טורקיה, ערב הסעודית ופקיסטן בהסכם הגנה משותף

headlines.title: Houthi attacks kill 58 Yemen troops, wound civilians in Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: Houthi attacks resulted in the deaths of 58 Yemen troops and wounded civilians in Saudi Arabia. This demonstrates the ongoing impact of the conflict.
headlines.title_he: פיגועי חות'ים הרגו 58 חיילים תימנים ופוצעו אזרחים בערב הסעודית

headlines.title: US top general reportedly seeks path out of Iran war as military options narrow
headlines.snippet: A US top general is reportedly seeking a way out of the Iran war as military options narrow. This suggests a shift in strategy regarding Iran.

headlines.title: Plane linked to German airport drone alert reportedly carried ammunition
headlines.snippet: A plane linked to a drone alert at a German airport reportedly carried ammunition. This finding raises security concerns related to air travel.
